findings.text: follow-on: _INTERVAL_UNIT_SECONDS.get(unit, 1.0) silently treats an unrecognised unit as seconds, so if REFRESH_INTERVAL is ever edited to a dialect the table omits (for example "5m", which no key matches) the derivation yields a 5-second shelf life with no error rather than failing, which is the opposite of the derivation's purpose.

item_verdicts.diff: read 36264f6abf83 against its parent cf17e5066b84d; it adds SHELF_LIFE_INTERVALS, _INTERVAL_UNIT_SECONDS, refresh_interval_seconds and suggested_shelf_life_seconds plus the document key in reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, a 66-line test file, and a 34-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_paid_lanes_document_states_its_shelf_life.py; its four cases assert 600 for 5min, 1200 under a patched 10min, the derivation identity, and through lane_context._budget_block a 345 s reading fresh and a 700 s reading stale; gate.log records 4 passed and negative_control.log is red at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to publish the paid-lanes document's shelf life as two refresh intervals; reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:459 adds "suggested_shelf_life_seconds": suggested_shelf_life_seconds() to compose_document, derived from REFRESH_INTERVAL.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md reports status complete, records the gate as 4 passed with EXIT=0, base_arm.log and head_arm.log each 356 passed, negative_control.log red at EXIT=1, and one landing line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt grants reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, tests/test_paid_lanes_document_states_its_shelf_life.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jev-learns-from-its-routes/paid-lanes-document-states-its-shelf-life.html and a figures directory; git show 36264f6abf83 changes the paid_lanes.py, the new test and the fragment only, and writes no figure.

justifications.durability: negative-control.log shows omitting the published key reddens three of the four cases -- including the 345 s reading at tests/test_paid_lanes_document_states_its_shelf_life.py:66 -- so the assertions fail on the exact regression the change prevents rather than passing regardless.
justifications.evidence: gate.log records 4 passed and negative_control.log records the omission reddening the 345 s reading (3 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1), but the test hand-builds the reading dict and so exercises the per-reading branch of lane_context._budget_block rather than the production _document_shelf_life_seconds path at reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py:359.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:151 hand-rolls a digit scan where reckon/crew/node.py:242 uses a compiled regex for the same shape of parse, and the added symbols carry no plan or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py:459 publishes suggested_shelf_life_seconds as refresh_interval_seconds() times SHELF_LIFE_INTERVALS (2), exactly the two-interval derivation the deliverable names, and it reads REFRESH_INTERVAL at call time.
justifications.reuse: the capability search over reckon found no owner of the systemd time-span dialect (min/sec/hour/d) that REFRESH_INTERVAL uses; reckon/crew/node.py:245, reckon/calibration.py:28 and reckon/flight.py:128 all parse only single-letter units, so this adds a fourth duration parser rather than extending one.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show 36264f6abf83 changes only reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, tests/test_paid_lanes_document_states_its_shelf_life.py and docs/evidence/fragments/jev-learns-from-its-routes/paid-lanes-document-states-its-shelf-life.html, all inside prompt.txt's granted write paths.
